definition_policy: Source definitions are namespaced. New package constructions do not silently replace historical senses. Machine-readable entries prescribe contracts; they do not certify implementation.

terms.definition: A specified space of configurations and admitted transformations with observation and validation interfaces.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Name states, operations, invariants and at least one explicit refusal.

terms.definition: The disciplined construction, comparison and testing of candidate substrates.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Record the candidate, baseline, test and outcome.

terms.definition: A versioned package of definitions, substrates, laws, methods, evidence, failures and cross-subject relations.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Resolve every included definition and source and report unavailable capabilities.

terms.definition: A declared set of distinguishable units used by formation rules, optionally typed and structured.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Give identity, membership and admissible use of each registered unit.

terms.definition: A lexical unit produced by a declared scanner from source text and source positions.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Preserve offsets and reject or retain unrecognized text explicitly.

terms.definition: A versioned specification of symbols and formation rules, with declared entry sorts and interpretation where supplied.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Distinguish membership, typing and evaluation.

terms.definition: A well-formed term in a declared grammar; it may denote a value, proposition or operation.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Return its typed syntax and assumptions before evaluation.

terms.definition: An expression or structured specification equipped with execution semantics and declared effects.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Bind execution model, permitted effects and refusal behavior.

terms.definition: A declared classification and constraint on values or operations used in admissibility judgments.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Reject a mismatched port rather than coerce silently.

terms.definition: The interpretation assigned to a well-formed expression relative to a declared semantic domain and context.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Identify the semantic domain and partiality.

terms.definition: The pinned assumptions, versions, environment and authority relevant to interpreting or executing an object.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Equal relevant inputs reproduce a deterministic resolution.

terms.definition: The identity of an exact source object and its custody record, distinct from its interpretation or execution.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Rehash original bytes without normalization.

terms.definition: Identity of a resolved operation including code, inputs, context, authority and nondeterminism policy.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Distinguish changed dependencies even when output bytes coincide.

terms.definition: A typed representation with source, context and interpretation metadata; it is not automatically its referent.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Separate representation identity from referent claims.

terms.definition: A source-linked corpus record for a term or form, its senses, analyses and claim statuses.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Resolve every source span and retain alternative analyses.

terms.definition: A higher-level symbol referring to a pinned grammar or certified construction and its typed boundary.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Resolve the original grammar and expansion contract.

terms.definition: Versioned admission of a certified construction as a reusable higher-level letter.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Check both exact expansion and separately stated semantic guarantees.

terms.definition: A declared map from a promoted letter to its lower-level representation.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Recover the stated representation exactly or declare loss.

terms.definition: Equality of declared observables between two interpretations under explicit assumptions.
terms.acceptance_obligation: State scope and evidence; finite examples do not establish a universal law.

terms.definition: A construction identifying objects under a specified equivalence relation.
terms.acceptance_obligation: State the equivalence and information no longer recoverable.

terms.definition: For a map f and output y, the set of inputs x satisfying f(x)=y.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Return a set-valued inverse when uniqueness is absent.

terms.definition: The equivalence x~x' defined by f(x)=f(x') for a specified map f.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Do not identify it with a linear nullspace without linear structure.

terms.definition: The nullspace of a linear map between declared vector spaces.
terms.acceptance_obligation: State scalar field, matrix shape and equation Av=0.

terms.definition: The set of outputs attained by a specified map on its admitted domain.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Distinguish algebraic image from rendered image.

terms.definition: An incidence object connecting explicitly named or ordered collections of ports, allowing arbitrary finite arity.
terms.acceptance_obligation: A multi-input rule cannot fire with one required input missing.

terms.definition: The inherited typed structure (V,H,P,tau,Omega,C,W,mu) for forms and evidence-bearing relations.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Validate incidence, context and evidence per strand.

terms.definition: One independently typed and graded claim about an entanglement's incidence.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Retain competing or rejected strands without conflation.

terms.definition: A quantifiable typed grammar-bearing relational incidence with content identity, plural metadata strands and compiled registered operations under a named versioned profile.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Record profile version; do not infer physical quantum computation.

terms.definition: One operation application with typed role bindings, context, outputs, evidence and loss/effect metadata.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Check all roles and compatible contexts before application.

terms.definition: A typed evidence-bearing derivation; a sequence for unary composition and a tree or DAG for joint-input composition.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Retain shared premises, ordering and joint enablement.

terms.definition: The historical directed labeled multigraph H=(V,E,Sigma,tau), whose composable relational edge paths form words in the declared alphabet.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Preserve source-specific meaning and refuse an untyped executable claim.

terms.definition: A typed bridge or composition between grammar packages with preserved contracts, evidence and loss declarations.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Supply source/target schemas and a positive and negative composition test.

terms.definition: A partial typed transformation or relation between representations with an explicit evidence and loss contract.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Matching field names alone cannot establish semantic equivalence.

terms.definition: The least fixed point of a declared consequence operator when the needed monotonicity and domain assumptions hold.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Distinguish fixed finite registry closure from unbounded generation.

terms.definition: Derivable from specified starting forms by admitted operations in a fixed context and search scope.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Return witness or bounded-search status; no path is not automatically impossibility.

terms.definition: Representing an operation or relation as a form at a declared reflection level.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Track levels and reject circular self-certification.

terms.definition: Replace letters by their declared lower-level blocks or paths.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Preserve expansion identity and declared boundaries.

terms.definition: Recognize a declared lower-level fold and return the corresponding higher-level letter, refusing invalid folds.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Reject a word outside the fold's image.

terms.definition: Construct a product alphabet whose letters carry the component coordinates.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Retain both coordinate projections.

terms.definition: Attach the fold framework to a domain through an explicit adapter.
terms.acceptance_obligation: State adapter invariants and losses.

terms.definition: The source's declared group-valued aggregate of an ordered event path.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Declare the group and aggregation order; do not claim physical transport.

terms.definition: A path that ends in the same machine state where it began.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Check start/end state equality under a named criterion.

terms.definition: A capability asserting a declared composition or closure law over a stated domain.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Supply a law and a scoped witness; distinguish plica.closable.

terms.definition: An alphabet whose declared successor forms a single cycle over all its letters.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Verify finite cycle coverage; do not imply logical completeness.

terms.definition: The source's scoped return/tower construction; no universal complexity or computability property is implied.
terms.acceptance_obligation: State the exact versioned predicate before claiming it.

terms.definition: A declared control/data system with states, events, guards, transitions, effects and observations.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Test admitted and refused transitions.

terms.definition: A named difference between two versioned states under a declared projection and comparison law.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Distinguish source, semantic, behavioral and view differences.

terms.definition: A decidable or explicitly bounded admission predicate checked before an operation is executed.
terms.acceptance_obligation: A failed or inconclusive guard cannot authorize an effect.

terms.definition: A declared change or interaction outside a pure returned value.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Record scope, intent, dispatch and outcome where external.

terms.definition: A property required to hold for admitted states or transitions in a declared domain.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Attach checker or proof obligations and counterexamples.

terms.definition: An immutable record of a committed command or observation with sufficient payload for its declared replay.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Rebuild from records without hidden tool reexecution.

terms.definition: An immutable state snapshot linked to history, sources, produced outputs and verification records.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Verify linked objects; distinguish from a Git commit.

terms.definition: Reconstructing recorded state from pinned events and results under the declared reducer.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Do not silently repeat external side effects.

terms.definition: A new execution attempting to obtain a prior result from pinned inputs and environment.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Issue a new run ID and report environmental differences.

terms.definition: A source-linked instruction or proposal addressed to a known target and governed by acknowledgement and effect tracking.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Submission and acknowledgement alone do not count as application.

terms.definition: Status indicating that actual output bytes have been captured for a requirement.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Require resolvable artifacts, not a caller-supplied success label.

terms.definition: Status for a captured version evaluated successfully by a registered verifier for its stated claim.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Bind verifier identity, inputs, evidence class and limitations.

terms.definition: A scoped completion decision grounded in current successful verification and required authority.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Reject stale verification or newly changed outputs.

terms.definition: A proof, computation, observation or attestation offered for a named claim under stated assumptions.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Name evidence class and independence; strings are not executable checkers.

terms.definition: A generate-seal-witness-compare run with declared and enforced information access boundaries.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Seal before witness access and label subsequent witness-informed revisions.

terms.definition: A versioned set of excluded patterns or refutation rules relative to a domain and evidence source.
terms.acceptance_obligation: A dataset exclusion cannot silently become physical impossibility.

terms.definition: An explicit result declining an operation because of a named unmet contract or unsupported capability.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Distinguish invalidity, unsupported method and exhausted budget.

terms.definition: A result indicating insufficient evidence or an unresolved interpretation.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Retain alternatives and conditions for resolution.

terms.definition: A run ended at a declared time, memory, search-depth or other budget.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Record budget consumed and do not infer impossibility.

terms.definition: A registered procedure constructing candidates with derivations from specifications, contexts, budgets and seeds.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Emit candidates and provenance without requiring LLM inference.

terms.definition: An optional declared predictive or generative model component behind typed input/output and evidence boundaries.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Its absence cannot break core no-LLM acceptance.

terms.definition: A versioned operation specification including schemas, guards, effects, authority, costs, failure and evidence behavior.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Check runtime capability against the contract before execution.

terms.definition: An operation that a package can demonstrably perform under its declared conditions.
terms.acceptance_obligation: A name or discovery manifest alone cannot grant authority.

terms.definition: Evidence supporting a scoped runnable, composable, replayable or other capability claim.
terms.acceptance_obligation: State predicate, domain, checker and negative controls.

terms.definition: Admissible and executable under the declared runtime, dependencies, authority and budget profile.
terms.acceptance_obligation: A clean invocation succeeds with stated outputs.

terms.definition: Compatible input/output types, contexts, effects and evidence thresholds admit the proposed combination.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Test incompatible contexts and conflicting effects.

terms.definition: A specified inverse restores declared observables over a stated domain.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Do not equate compensation with exact inverse execution.

terms.definition: A named read-only projection exposes declared quantities together with its losses and uncertainty.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Reading must not mutate authoritative domain state.

terms.definition: A proposed new or improved construction relative to a declared baseline with a falsifiable objective.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Record novelty scope, cost and counterexamples.

terms.definition: A versioned activation of a candidate after the required comparative evidence and compatibility checks.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Retain predecessor, evidence, migration and reversal policy.

terms.definition: A vector of source, conceptual, constructive, verification and teaching coverage over a declared inventory.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Do not report source ingestion as solved operational competence.

terms.definition: Versioned unresolved questions, absent bridges, hypotheses, limits and candidate improvements.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Every frontier item names an executable or scholarly next test.

terms.definition: A typed primitive (I,O,Q,delta,g,e,w,c) with guards, effects, witness and cost bound.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Preserve the exact ATOM phase and admission semantics in an adapter.

terms.definition: Camera, layout and transient presentation controls separate from persistent semantic machine state.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Camera motion cannot silently mutate a corpus relation.

terms.definition: The rooted parent-child arborescence, distinct from cyclic support or dependency couplings.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Check one structural parent and acyclicity separately from coupling edges.

terms.definition: A verified, portable, self-describing output that may seed another machine or package.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Resolve its source, build recipe, interfaces and verification receipt.

terms.definition: A stable cross-section reference identifying a persistent obligation family.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Preserve meaning when sections or implementation phases change.

terms.definition: The package's new mnemonic: Deliverable, Obligations, Dependencies, Guards, Evidence.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Each work item names all five fields and its source references.

terms.definition: A higher-arity Q relation with ordered typed input/output roles and separate contextual evidence strands.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Refuse a missing required premise or incompatible role.

terms.definition: A port-checked composition of G-ship edges or Q-Strings.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Check all typed ports, contexts and effects.

terms.definition: A versioned self-identifying locator for stored Q content; dereference requires the referenced store and schema.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Resolve exact bytes; do not pretend to invert a digest.

terms.definition: Indexes and materialized views over Q records with explicit workload, construction, storage and invalidation costs.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Measure output-sensitive cost and freshness.

terms.definition: The inherited package tuple (id,version,Sigma,G,I,O,delta,Gamma,epsilon,P,C,B), independently specifiable and testable.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Distinguish it from Astra ATOM and declare every dependency.

terms.definition: The inherited (Grammar,Enumerator,Typechecker,Compiler,Executor,Verifier) construction for generating and checking programs.
terms.acceptance_obligation: A produced program passes compiler, effect and verification contracts.

terms.definition: A grammar specification with formalism, semantics, operand types, witnesses and effects, accepted before metageneration.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Reject a card lacking denotation or admissibility scope.

terms.definition: Artifact, typed derivation, source/grammar versions, machine trace, invariant checks, refusals, unresolved items, replay manifest and hash.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Every referenced input and output is resolvable.

terms.definition: A versioned per-variety language bundle (VarietyID,Sigma,O,T,P,M,X,E) plus negative grammar.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Keep sound, orthography, phonotactics, morphology, lexicon and evidence distinct.

terms.definition: A level, feature, status, replacement and evidence record for a scoped linguistic absence or contrast.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Missing data is not promoted to an attested absence.

terms.definition: A proposed intersection of cross-pack attested features, recomputed from the scoped dataset.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Record attestation counts and counterexamples; do not assume universality.

terms.definition: The common variety-ID, IPA/feature-stream and evidence boundary for language-pack interoperability.
terms.acceptance_obligation: Shared schema does not imply shared phonology or proven cognacy.
